slowQueries.description: List of operations that the Performance Advisor detected that took longer to execute than a specified threshold.

PerformanceAdvisorSlowQuery.description: Details of one slow query that the Performance Advisor detected.

line.description: Text of the MongoDB log related to this slow query.

namespace.description: Human-readable label that identifies the namespace on the specified host. The resource expresses this parameter value as `<database>.<collection>`.

opType.description: Operation type (read/write/command) associated with this slow query log.

replicaState.description: Replica state associated with this slow query log.

PerformanceAdvisorSlowQueryMetrics.description: Metrics from a slow query log.

docsExamined.description: The number of documents in the collection that MongoDB scanned in order to carry out the operation.

docsExaminedReturnedRatio.description: Ratio of documents examined to documents returned.

docsReturned.description: The number of documents returned by the operation.

fromUserConnection.description: This boolean will be true when the server can identify the query source as non-server. This field is only available for MDB 8.0+.

hasIndexCoverage.description: Indicates if the query has index coverage.

hasSort.description: This boolean will be true when a query cannot use the ordering in the index to return the requested sorted results; i.e. MongoDB must sort the documents after it receives the documents from a cursor.

keysExamined.description: The number of index keys that MongoDB scanned in order to carry out the operation.

keysExaminedReturnedRatio.description: Ratio of keys examined to documents returned.

numYields.description: The number of times the operation yielded to allow other operations to complete.

operationExecutionTime.description: Total execution time of a query in milliseconds.

responseLength.description: The length in bytes of the operation's result document.
